rule: Every fact, quote, and storyline in a published edition traces to a source registered here, dated at or before the edition's cutoff.

source_classes.what: The complete league-data source for the preseason edition, projected from the compiled cutoff-bound edition state: team identities, draft, offseason transactions, historical results, complete cutoff rosters, exact chat quotes with fact_id references. The bundle itself is local private custody (gitignored); the tracked manifest carries edition, cutoff, canonical hash, counts, lineage, and the regeneration command. Writer preflight: python scripts/build_preseason_evidence.py --verify (rejects an absent or hash-mismatched bundle). The preseason writer opens the bundle and contemporaneous coverage, nothing else.

Weekly data packet: matchups, standings, awards, per-game NFL context (scores, lines, injuries, weather, EPA), all fields derived as-of the edition's week. Weekly editions only; the preseason edition uses preseason_evidence instead.

Sanitized league chat for the edition: verbatim quotes, storylines, and league memory admitted by exact timestamp at or before the cutoff. Weekly editions only; the preseason edition uses preseason_evidence instead.
Franchise records, titles, playoff runs, rosters, draft classes, player arcs. Weekly editions only; the preseason edition uses preseason_evidence instead.
Team identity: roster_id, team name, owner.
Structured editorial decisions accepted by the league (e.g. an accepted ranking order).
Editions already published by this system; the callback surface.

paths: (external; cite URL + publication date in the edition's source notes)
source_classes.what: NFL articles, reports, and takes published at or before the edition's cutoff, cited with their publication date. Coverage dated after the cutoff is inadmissible.
